drawer.schemaIntro: Choose a schedule package to apply, or edit the schedule directly.
drawer.packageInfo: A schedule package contains activities divided into Morning, Day and Evening. Choose a package and it replaces the child's current weekly schedule.

nnl.lead: Enable for a structured morning/evening routine
nnl.tooltip: Guided order — your child sees NOW, Next and Later and checks off one at a time. Off by default, your child can choose which activity to check off.

mood.tooltip: Your child drags a slider (sad → happy) right after checking off an activity. Gives you insight into how they feel during the day.

reorder.tooltip: Lets your child drag activities into a new order in their day view. Good for older children who want more control.

hideClock.tooltip: Hides the clock and timestamps in the child view. Reduces stress for children who are time-sensitive or worry about "making it in time".

lockSchedule.tooltip: Stops your child browsing to other days or skipping activities. Good for children who need clear boundaries and focus on the present.

dopamin.tooltip: Shows a quick star and confetti animation when your child checks off an activity. Reinforces accomplishment without blocking the next step.

visualTimer.tooltip: Shows a circular shrinking Time Timer during an ongoing activity — based on start and end time. Visual only, no numbers. Helps children understand how much time is left.

timeAdjustment.label: Time adjustment
timeAdjustment.tooltip: Shows the "Postpone all" button in the daily log — parents can push all upcoming activities forward by 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes. Affects only today's log, not the template.

colorCoding.tooltip: Colour-codes activity cards by type (e.g. blue = hygiene, yellow = food, green = play). Shown in both child and parent views. Helps quickly identify activity type.
